name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for the 24 Hours of Le Mans, a local event he attended religiously with his father. After excelling in technical studies, he landed an internship at a small engineering firm specializing in vehicle dynamics. His keen eye for detail and relentless pursuit of perfection quickly made him an invaluable asset. At Proton by Premotion, Jean-Pierre ensures that every component and process meets the highest standards, striving to push the boundaries of performance while maintaining unwavering reliability.

Jean-Pierre is deeply committed to continuous improvement, constantly seeking innovative solutions to optimize quality control procedures. His approach is methodical yet adaptable, allowing him to quickly identify and address potential issues before they escalate. He believes that a proactive and collaborative approach is essential for achieving excellence in a high-pressure environment.

physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with diagrams and notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on calibrating his tools before every shift, regardless of whether they need it or not.
